result.stdout:
codout-mcp - Codout Framework MCP server

Usage:
  codout-mcp                Run as MCP stdio server (default).
  codout-mcp --validate     Print knowledge pack status and exit.
  codout-mcp --list-tools   List MCP tools exposed by the server and exit.
  codout-mcp --version      Print version and exit.
  codout-mcp --help         Show this help.

Environment:
  CODOUT_MCP_CodoutAi__DocsRoot   Override path to docs/ai (filesystem source).
